# IMAX: The Ronson Theatre

IMAX: The Ronson Theatre

Feel every rumble. See every detail. Experience the big screen.

Experience one of London’s most immersive cinema experiences at our IMAX. With one of the biggest screens in the UK and one of only two cinemas in Europe capable of showing both digital and 70mm IMAX film, this is cinema on an unforgettable scale. 

Settle in for breathtaking journeys across the wild plains of Antarctica, step back to the wonder year of the T. rex, dive into the secrets of the ocean or explore life aboard the International Space Station.  

Our incredible documentaries bring science and discovery to life in spectacular detail so grab some popcorn and drinks from our concessions area, sit back and enjoy a cinematic experience like no other.  

## What makes our IMAX theatre special?

Our next-generation IMAX® Laser 4K projector, combined with our much-loved IMAX 70mm film projector, allows you to experience films with stunning clarity, vibrant colour and incredible scale, making every visit a truly unforgettable experience. Our IMAX is perfect for: 

- Families looking for a memorable day out
- Rainy day activities in London
- Weekend plans and school holiday visits
- Adding something special to a museum trip

## Visit information

Find out when to visit, tickets, prices and best value options:

## Visit information

### Booking tickets

#### How can I book tickets?

 

- Tickets can be booked via the individual documentary pages listed under currently showing.
- We’d recommend booking ahead of your visit to get cheaper prices.
- Tickets will also be available to book at a ticket desk on the day.
- You will receive your e-tickets via email which can be scanned upon arrival at the IMAX cinema.
- Please book a free museum general admission ticket in advance of your visit.

#### What are showing times?

Showing times are at 11.00, 12.30, 14.00 and 15.30 on weekdays and at 11.00, 12.15, 13.30, 15.00 and 16.15 on weekends. Please check our visit us page for the latest museum opening days and times. 

#### Are there any discounts available?

Save even more on tickets for earlier and later screenings each day when you book at least a day before your visit.  

Find out more in [our FAQs](https://www.sciencemuseum.org.uk/ticket-prices-faqs). 

#### Can we bring school groups?

Yes, groups are welcome. Please [head to our Group Visits page](https://www.sciencemuseum.org.uk/groups) to find out how to book your visit.  

### About your visit

#### Are you serving food/drinks? Can I bring my own food/drink?

We sell drinks and snacks in our concessions area. You can bring your own bottle of water, however food from outside the IMAX cinema is not permitted. 

#### How long before showing do I need to arrive?

Please try to arrive at the cinema ten minutes before the time printed on your tickets.  

#### Will toilets be available?

There are toilet facilities available near the concessions area and towards the back of the IMAX cinema on level 3.  

### Accessibility

#### Is there step-free access to the auditorium and concession area?

Yes, there is step free access to the auditorium. Please ask at our IMAX ticket desk and a staff member will escort you to your seats. 

#### Are there spaces reserved for wheelchair users in the auditorium?

Yes, there are four spaces available for wheelchair users. Please call our call centre on 033 0058 0058 to book. 

#### Do you provide hearing loops?

Yes, we do have hearing loops available. Just speak to a member of staff upon arrival. 

#### Do your films have subtitles?

Our educational films do not currently contain subtitles, however this is something we are looking to review for the future. 

#### Are there accessible toilet facilities?

Yes, accessible toilets are located near the IMAX concessions area and outside the main auditorium.

What to expect from your IMAX cinema experience:

## About our IMAX cinema

### Is the IMAX cinema included in free Science Museum entry?

Entry to the Science Museum is free, but IMAX screenings require a separate paid ticket.

 

### What makes the Science Museum IMAX special?

The Science Museum IMAX features one of the biggest screens in the UK, alongside next-generation IMAX Laser 4K projection and a 70mm film projector. This makes it one of only two cinemas in Europe capable of showing both digital and 70mm IMAX film.

The cinema features modern seating to enjoy films and events in maximum comfort, while our concessions area completes  the cinema-going experience with relaxed seating and refreshments bar.

### What can I watch at the IMAX cinema?

The Science Museum IMAX cinema shows a mix of educational documentaries, blockbuster films and special 70mm screenings throughout the year.

You can expect to see:

- Daily educational documentaries exploring science, nature, space, engineering and human achievement, designed to inspire curiosity for visitors of all ages
- Blockbuster films presented on one of the UK’s biggest screens, with immersive IMAX sound and projection
- Film seasons and special screenings, including themed programmes, classic films and limited-run events.

### How long are IMAX films?

Our daily educational documentaries are 60 minutes long including a few minutes for adverts. If you’re visiting one of our blockbuster film screenings, the run-time will vary from film to film.   

### Who is the IMAX cinema best for?

The IMAX cinema is suitable for visitors aged 5 and over, making it a great option for families, school-age children and adults alike. Our daily educational documentaries are typically rated U or PG and are designed to inspire curiosity across a wide range of ages. The immersive IMAX experience includes 3D glasses and powerful sound, so we recommend the cinema for children aged 5+ who are comfortable wearing the glasses and sitting through a film. If you’re visiting to see a blockbuster IMAX film, then please check the individual film listing for age recommendations. 

### What is IMAX with laser?

IMAX with Laser is IMAX’s most advanced cinematic experience yet. It delivers increased resolution, crystal clear projection, sharper and brighter images, deeper contrasts as well as the widest range of colours available to filmmakers. Combined with the introduction of IMAX’s incredible 12-channel precision sound system, it produces a thrillingly immersive 3D sound experience.  

### What is 70mm film/projection?

70mm film projection is one of the highest quality projection formats available. With an aspect ratio of 1.43:1, IMAX 70mm film offers viewers up to 40% more film image on screen than in standard cinemas, combining the largest, clearest images with specially created sound for a high-quality viewing experience. A favourite among film makers and film buffs, the format was discussed by Director and Academy-Award winning Visual Effects Designer, Paul Franklin (Inception, Interstellar) on the [Science Museum blog.](https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fblog.sciencemuseum.org.uk%2F2001-a-space-odyssey-unrestored%2F%3Futm_source%3DPress%26utm_medium%3DPress%2520Release%26utm_campaign%3DL%2520AP%253A%2520IMAX%252025%252F11%252F20&data=05%7C02%7Cweb.team%40ScienceMuseum.ac.uk%7C3047b42e0eb34513c12008de9713fb4b%7Ce967bcc0c07041c89f7e806069f6330b%7C1%7C0%7C639114309431768059%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=NVYh%2BJeLTP4LC%2BK9EJU9OTEJ7FYFbCfxSkr%2FznuMc5A%3D&reserved=0) 

Our educational films are shown in IMAX with Laser. We have recently announced our [IMAX 70mm Season](https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sciencemuseum.org.uk%2Fsee-and-do%2Fimax-70mm-season&data=05%7C02%7Cweb.team%40ScienceMuseum.ac.uk%7Ceb6c511e5702496be92508ddda63d703%7Ce967bcc0c07041c89f7e806069f6330b%7C1%7C0%7C638906844527189057%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=MWB9ASPqSU5HgH8o345%2BL%2Bh6GrQWwxRCtaVH5%2Fa2Xz4%3D&reserved=0) that includes screenings of 70mm film classics throughout the autumn.

Our inspirational exhibitions, astounding galleries and
creative blank canvas spaces, combine to make the
Science Museum one of London’s most unique venues
for corporate or private hire.

Located in South Kensington, the cultural heart of
London, the museum offers the perfect destination
for an inspirational event experience in a central
location. The Science Museum has a wide range
of unique galleries and blank canvas spaces to
accommodate from 10 to 1500 guests.

 ILLUMINATE


Illuminate is a progressive venue that anticipates
and surpasses the needs of the ever-evolving events
industry.

Illuminate is situated on levels four and five of the
Science Museum and is available for both daytime
and evening hire for capacities of up to 400 for
dinners and conferences and 450 for receptions.

One of the unique features of this space is a
panoramic window on level five offering stunning
views of the City and an abundance of natural
daylight, a key element in ensuring a productive
meeting or conference experience.

 SMITH CENTRE


Originally constructed in 1890, the Smith Centre
has been elegantly preserved to present four spaces
of varying size that suit a range of event purposes.
From small meeting rooms for up to 20 guests, to an
ample-sized Salon accommodating 200 guests for a
canapé reception.

Among the original features is an open-plan
Courtyard area which can be enjoyed in conjunction
with daytime hire of the Salon. The space is also
enhanced with a range of hand-picked historical
objects from the Science Museum collection,
including a replica pressure suit from the last mission
to the Moon and the stunning Electrical Engineering
Workshop painting by Terence Cuneo.

 ENERGY HALL


Showcasing the past and present of Britain’s
engineering history and its achievements since the
Industrial Revolution, this striking space is available for
evening hire. It is perfect for standing receptions of up
to 500 guests.

Utilise the unique branding opportunities in this space;
we have four plasma screens can be used for your own
company branding, and you can select your corporate
colour for the colour-phasing ceiling.

Reception: 500
 SPACE


An iconic gallery which showcases out-of-this-world
objects and spacecrafts. Located in the museum’s
West Hall, Space brings together remarkable exhibits
that celebrate both the first space age and the future
of space exploration.

Space is available for evening hire and ideal for drinks
receptions for up to 400 guests or dinners for up to
200.

Your guests can marvel at the radio headset Neil
Armstrong used to communicate with Mission Control,
the Sokol spacesuit worn by Helen Sharman, the first
Briton in space and last but not the least, a three-
billion-year-old piece of the moon, brought back to
Earth by the Apollo 15.

Reception: 400
 MEDICINE: THE
WELLCOME GALLERIES

Medicine: The Wellcome Galleries is a suite of five
vast and visually stunning new galleries. With over
3,000 objects in what is the world’s largest collection
of medical galleries, there are plenty of stories for
your guests to explore on how our lives have been
transformed by medical research and practice.

Guests can mingle among scientifically significant
objects such as an original a full-sized pharmacy from
1911, a rare Iron lung, and the first MRI scanner.

Accommodating up to 400 guests, you can now
hire the Medicine Galleries for an evening drinks
reception and 60 guests for a seated dinner.

Long table dinner: 60
 FLIGHT


An extraordinary collection which reflects worldwide
achievements in aviation, in this breath-taking replica
aircraft hangar. Invite your guests to dine and dance
beneath the incredible icons of aviation history.

Flight gallery will take you on a journey from the
flight dreams of the Renaissance through to the
jump-jet and the wide-body aeroplanes of today
with a host of full-sized aircraft, aircraft models, and
commemorative exhibits. Your guests can get up
close to the aircraft on the overhead walkways.

Flight gallery is available for both daytime and
evening hire.

 IMAX: THE RONSON
THEATRE

Choose our IMAX Theatre for a daytime or evening
event with maximum impact. With a large screen,
an 11.5m-wide stage, it is the premier location for
large-scale conferences.

The IMAX: The Ronson Theatre uses image-maximum
technology, state-of-the-art surround sound system,
and one of the world’s most sophisticated projectors.
Daytime hire of comes complete with the use of
our IMAX foyer for catering areas. Our Flight gallery
located close by can additionally be hired for catering
as well.

Our in-house technical team can provide event support
or work with your chosen production company.

 WONDERLAB


Fuel your imagination and immerse yourself in a world
of wonder at the newest and most interactive gallery
in the world.

Spread across seven different zones, there’s loads
of opportunity to get hands on with science. Order
live experiments at our Chemistry Bar, see lightning
strike before your eyes or travel through space under
a canopy of stars. You can also take part in explosive
science demonstrations and shows, led by our
talented team of Explainers.

This interactive gallery is also the perfect space for
Christmas parties, corporate receptions and
Bar/Bat Mitzvah celebrations.

 MATHEMATICS:
THE WINTON GALLERY

Designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, this gallery
examines the fundamental role mathematicians,
their tools and ideas have played in building the
world we live in.

These stories span 400 years of human ingenuity
from the renaissance to the present day, with objects
ranging from intriguing handheld mathematical
instruments to a 1929 experimental aircraft.

The curved overhead structure and layout of the
gallery represents airflow around the Handley Page
aircraft suspended at its centre.

Dinner on rounds: 30
Long table: 24
 INFORMATION AGE


A fascinating space celebrating more than 200 years
of innovation in information and communication
technologies, it is the perfect venue for standing
drinks receptions or thought provoking panel
discussions.

Information Age is divided into six zones, each
representing a different technology network. Invite
your guests to relive remarkable moments in history,
from the first BBC radio broadcast in 1922 to the
dawn of digital TV. They can also see where
Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth sent her first Tweet,
when she opened the gallery in 2014.

Information Age is available for both daytime and
evening hire.

 POWER UP


Power Up is our interactive, hands-on gaming
experience showcasing the best video games and
consoles spanning 50 years, from Pong to Pacman,
Minecraft to Mario.

Whether you are a retro games fan, a dedicated
gamer, or seeking some Mario Kart rivalry with
colleagues, there’s something for everyone. Engage
in multiplayer showdowns, relive your childhood
favourites, and explore cutting-edge virtual reality
experiences in this ultimate interactive gaming
adventure.

Available for evening events accommodating up to
200 guests. This gallery promises an unforgettable
time filled with nostalgia, friendly competition, and
the latest gaming technology.
